description: Defines several report models for sales and turnover data in an Odoo module, including SQL view initialization for reports on sales by product, category, turnover per month/product, and recent sale orders.

classes.name: report_sale_order_product
classes.description: Report model for sales orders by products, backed by a SQL view.

classes.name: report_sale_order_category
classes.description: Report model for sales orders by categories, backed by a SQL view.

classes.name: report_turnover_per_month
classes.description: Report model for turnover per month, backed by a SQL view.

classes.name: report_turnover_per_product
classes.description: Report model for turnover per product, backed by a SQL view.

classes.name: report_sale_order_created
classes.description: Report model for recently created sale orders within the last 15 days, backed by a SQL view.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SQL views for each report model.
